title: $1,000 in Apple in 2007 is now worth this
caption:
In 2007, Apple was about to launch the iPhone.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:AAPL:2007-01-03} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Apple in 2007? 👇
sources: Apple price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time
